description: This file defines the WatchReplyCoordinator class, which manages the state and processing of quick reply events on an Apple Watch app. It handles deduplication, queuing, and forwarding of reply events based on connection status.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A coordinator responsible for managing WatchQuickReplyEvent instances, including deduplication, queuing when the gateway is disconnected, and forwarding when connected.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes an incoming WatchQuickReplyEvent, deduplicating, queuing if disconnected, or forwarding if connected.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the gateway is connected and clears the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Reinsert an event at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued events.
